title: Query
tryWithClaude: Ask Claude: which product category had the best margin last year?

steps.say: Query answers a question about your numbers. Choose Words and type it in plain words.
Press Ask and the answer comes back with the way it was read. Semanticus checks it before it shows you.
You can ask about time too. Net sales and gross margin rose each quarter.
steps.sayOwn: You can ask about time too, like your numbers by month.

steps.say: Press another visual that fits to see the same numbers another way. The DAX beside the answer is the query that ran.
To go deeper, press a number in the Result to explain it, or measure the query's speed.
